with a pout.definitionKo: 곧 울음이 터져 나오려고 하는 모양.
with a pout.englishDescription: In the state of being about to cry.

with a pout.definitionKo: 자꾸 입술이나 귀 등을 빳빳하게 세우거나 뾰족하게 내미는 모양.
with a pout.englishDescription: In the manner of sticking out one's lips or making one's ears stand erect.
with a pout.englishExpression: with a pout; with a prick

with a pout.definitionKo: 무엇을 비웃거나 기분이 나쁘거나 울음이 나오려고 해서 소리 없이 입을 내밀고 실룩거리는 모양.
with a pout.englishDescription: A word describing one pouting and twisting one's mouth in silence, when one mocks someone, feels bad, or is about to cry.

with a pout.definitionKo: 기분이 좋지 않거나 울려고 할 때, 또는 비웃을 때 소리 없이 입을 쑥 내밀고 실룩거리는 모양.
with a pout.englishDescription: A word describing one pouting and twitching one's mouth without making a sound, when one feels bad, wants to cry, or sneers at someone.

with a pout.definitionKo: 무엇을 비웃거나 기분이 나쁘거나 울음이 나오려고 해서 소리 없이 입을 내미는 모양.
with a pout.englishDescription: A word describing one pouting one's mouth in silence, when one mocks someone, feels bad, or is about to cry.

with a splash.definitionKo: 큰 물체가 물에 부딪치거나 잠기는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a splash.englishDescription: A word used to describe the sound made when something heavy falls into the water or sinks, or such a motion.
with a splash.englishExpression: with a splash; with a plop

with a splash.definitionKo: 손이나 물건 등의 넓적한 면으로 깊지 않은 물을 거칠게 치는 소리.
with a splash.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a palm or the flat side of an object hits shallow water strongly.

with a splash.definitionKo: 많은 양의 액체가 큰 물결을 이루며 넘칠 듯이 흔들리는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a splash.englishDescription: A word used to describe the sound made when a large amount of liquid, etc., forms big waves and rolls as if to overflow, or such a motion.
with a splash.englishExpression: with a slash; with a splash

with a splash.definitionKo: 얕은 물이나 진흙탕을 거칠게 밟거나 치는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a splash.englishDescription: A word used to describe the sound made when one treads on or hits shallow water or mud forcefully, or such a motion.
with a splash.englishExpression: with a splash; with a splosh

with a splash.definitionKo: 아주 많은 양의 액체가 단단한 물체에 세게 부딪치는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a splash.englishDescription: A word used to describe the splashing sound made when a large amount of liquid hits a hard object forcefully, or such a motion.

with a splash.definitionKo: 얕은 물이나 진흙탕을 거칠게 밟거나 치는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a splash.englishDescription: A word used to describe the sound made when one treads on or hits shallow water or mud forcefully, or such a motion.
with a splash.englishExpression: with a splash; with a splosh

with a splash.definitionKo: 물이 고인 곳이나 질퍽한 땅 등을 세게 밟거나 치는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a splash.englishDescription: A word used to describe the sound made when one treads on or hits shallow water or mud forcefully, or such a motion.
with a splash.englishExpression: with a splash; with a splosh

with a splash.definitionKo: 물이 고인 곳이나 질퍽한 땅 등을 세게 밟거나 치는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a splash.englishDescription: A word used to describe the sound made when one treads or hits shallow water or mud forcefully, or such a motion.
with a splash.englishExpression: with a splash; with a splosh

with a throb.englishDescription: A word describing the state of one's heart or pulse throbbing heavily.

with a throb.definitionKo: 심장이나 맥박이 자꾸 크게 뛰는 모양.
with a throb.englishDescription: A word describing one's heart or pulse throbbing heavily and repeatedly.

with a throb.definitionKo: 심장이나 맥이 작게 자꾸 뛰는 모양.
with a throb.englishDescription: A word describing one's heart or pulse throbbing lightly and repeatedly.
A word describing one's heart or pulse throbbing lightly.

with plops.definitionKo: 큰 물체가 물에 자꾸 부딪치거나 잠기는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with plops.englishDescription: A word used to describe the sounds made when large objects fall into the water or sink, or such a motion.

with plops.definitionKo: 크고 무거운 물체가 깊은 물에 계속해서 떨어지거나 빠질 때 나는 소리.
with plops.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when big and heavy objects fall or are dropped into deep water repeatedly.

with plops.definitionKo: 작고 단단한 물건이 계속 물에 떨어지거나 빠질 때 가볍게 나는 소리.
with plops.englishDescription: A word imitating the light sound made when small and hard objects fall or are dropped into deep water.

with quick snatches.definitionKo: 무엇을 재빨리 자꾸 입에 넣거나 손에 쥐어 가지는 모양.
with quick snatches.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of putting something into one's mouth or grasping something quickly and repeatedly.

with quick snatches.definitionKo: 무엇을 자꾸 빠르게 입에 넣거나 손에 쥐어 가지는 모양.
with quick snatches.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of putting something into one's mouth or grasping something quickly and repeatedly.

with repeated startles.englishDescription: In the manner of being startled suddenly and frequently.

woodwork.definitionKo: 나무로 가구 등의 물건을 만드는 일.
woodwork.englishDescription: The act of  making things out of wood, such as funiture.

write off.definitionKo: 빚이나 요금, 세금 등의 물어야 할 것을 덜어 주다.
write off.englishDescription: To reduce the amount of a debt, utility bill, tax, etc.

yakgwa.definitionKo: 꿀, 기름, 밀가루를 섞은 반죽을 판에 박아서 모양을 낸 뒤 기름에 지지거나 튀겨서 만든 과자.
yakgwa.englishDescription: A Korean confectionary made by pressing dough made with wheat flour, honey and oil into molds and frying or deep-frying the molded dough pieces.

yours sincerely.definitionKo: 절하여 올린다는 뜻으로, 예스럽거나 격식을 갖춘 편지의 마지막에 자기 이름 뒤에 쓰는 말.
yours sincerely.englishDescription: A phrase written behind one's name when writing an old-styled or formal letter, which means presenting with a bow.
